2558-2829-6277--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-2829-6277--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
On Wings of Gold triggers. Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token. The +1/+1 bonus from On Wings of Gold is countered by the -1/-1 from the templated card
Repeat from step 2.

2645-3257-3430-4644.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3257-3430-4644.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-2443-2841-7893.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-7893.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with eight or more +1/+1 counters on it
attached to any creature you control except Sekki

1475-1724-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sekki
When Sekki dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating at least eight 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1475-1724-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2393-2738-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead, adding {B}.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a token.
Activate that token by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead, adding {B}.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate that Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2073-2438-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

553-2093-4838.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Najal.
In response, cast Lapse of Certainty by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-7329-7803.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
539-3899-4552-7329-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-3899-4552-7329-7803.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1879-3010-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3010-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

489-4200-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-3099-4762-6627.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

240-4050-4742-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3771-6072-7182.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
3771-6072-7182.description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-997-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-997-7281.notes: If desired, you can cast Leonardo's Technique for its sneak cost instead, reducing the mana cost by {2}.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5226-6972-7159.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

3215-5411-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2366-3430-5702-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-5702-6968.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

862-997-5220-6900.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3053-3918-5200.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four basic land types among lands you control
3053-3918-5200.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {4}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
3053-3918-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-3129-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-3129-4365.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

513-527-3499.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-3499.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

4613-4968-5292.description:
Activate Voice of the Blessed by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Voice of the Blessed triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1808-2034-6291.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

168-526-5193-6441.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
168-526-5193-6441.description:
Cast Anikthea from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring from your graveyard and creating two token copies of it that are 3/3 Zombies.
When the Oblivion Ring tokens enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Anikthea until the Oblivion Ring token leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the second Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling the first Oblivion Ring token.
When the first Oblivion Ring token is exiled, Anikthea returns to the battlefield from exile.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, choosing not to exile anything.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating two token copies of the Oblivion Ring token.
Repeat from step 4.

2018-2034-3216.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Suncleanser, adding {C}{C}.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Repeat.

850-1247-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures with defender.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
850-1247-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Overgrown Battlement's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

413-586-5258-5618-6121.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

1238-2351-2921-5467-5929.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

2018-2034-3532-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have flying.
2018-2034-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature without flying, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing the flying counter from the creature sacrificed in step 2.
Repeat.

2-338-1496-2060.notablePrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
2-338-1496-2060.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Ancestral Statue's toughness.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}.
Repeat.

2757-3841-4770.description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Torens triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Whitemane Lion, untapping the Plains.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Human Soldier token, untapping the Plains.
Repeat.

152-851-1283-4600.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap the Chromatic Orrery tokens to draw infinite cards, or target any artifact(s) using Cogwork Assembler's ability.

500-2557-4688-4840.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Myr Battlesphere and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
The Myr Battlesphere tokens enter the battlefield, creating thirty-two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

174-339-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Jegantha.
Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
174-339-2178-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
Worldheart Phoenix dies, triggering Jegantha, untapping Jegantha.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.

3038-4769.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block your commander.
3038-4769.description:
Declare your commander as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
Sovereigns of Lost Alara's exalted and second abilities trigger.
Resolve Sovereigns of Lost Alara's exalted trigger, giving your commander +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Sovereigns of Lost Alara's second ability, searching your library for Colossification, putting it onto the battlefield attached to your commander, and shuffling your library.
Deal combat damage with your commander.
The opponent that was dealt damage loses the game due to being dealt at least twenty-one combat damage by your commander.

413-3026-4302-4802.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Angel.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters.
The Spirit token enters the battlefield as a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Blasting Station and Bishop of Wings.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve Blasting Station's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the Spirit token.
Repeat from step 2.

2882-3518-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-3518-4675-4694.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Lion's Eye Diamond enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
